name: AuxPair.realPairWeil_harmonicPoly
summary: Write harmonicPoly through the mixed Cartan embedding, which intertwines the action of y on coordinate vectors with the actions on the two tensor factors; expand the vector in the standard basis and apply realPairWeil_fockLetters to each letter polynomial.

steps.claim: conj(conjWeylRep(y) xi) is the conjugate matrix of y in the weight representation applied to conj xi, written with a transposed matrix.

Unfold harmonicPoly(O) = tensorPoly(O) after mixedCartan; the mixed Cartan embedding intertwines the weight representation with the tensor product of the representations on the positive and negative letters.
Expand the vector as the sum of its coordinates times standard basis vectors.
Apply realPairWeil_fockLetters (with signs(O), ord(O), gamma', y) to each letter polynomial of a product tensor; the Fock vectors are determined by their polynomials, and the sums agree.
steps.lean:
simp [by simpa [realPairWeil_polyVector, polyVector_injective.eq_iff] using
    realPairWeil_fockLetters O.signs O.ord γ' y, mulVec_sum, sum_prod_type, ← vec_single,
    realPairWeil_polyVector, single_eq_single_vecMulVec_single, letterPoly, -mulVec_single]
